discussion.body: Act 4 storyboard. Locations: King's Sea ferry, Iunum court, Valley of Songs, Queen's Cove, Temple of Water. Join: Nym (FEAT-032). Beats: elven court will not commit ships to a human-dwarf war; Liraen home sequence and song-duel sideline; Cove docks, airship frame exists and does not fly; Water dungeon and Undertow Sigil; Invasion smoke on the east cape. Death crisis: Nym at the dock fire if the party chases salvage instead of the pump line. Default live. Contingency: Cove shipwrights finish the airship from her notes in Act 7. If Bengenia was wiped, Iunum treats the party as plague-bearers and the court scene is colder; still one act, one later ending. Frames: ferry, court, song hall, docks, water sanctum.
